status: T3 COMPUTABLE-SCAFFOLD; stage-1 spatial and stage-2 finite-time audits PASS

continuum_problem.field: Psi in C^3, treated as six real components
continuum_problem.flow: partial_t Psi = -R[Psi], where R is the real-L2 gradient of the P1 reference functional
continuum_problem.regularity_input: P2 gives a unique global H2 solution and C-infinity smoothing for every t>0
continuum_problem.scope: pinned production parameters, positive rho and Class-II mass regularisers, eta_shell=0

spatial_discretization.space: S_N = three-component trigonometric polynomials on the fftfreq cube
spatial_discretization.projector: P_N is the real-L2 Fourier projector onto S_N
spatial_discretization.collocation_residual: R_N^C is the hash-pinned P1 backend gradient of the collocation energy
spatial_discretization.dealiasing_rule: Stage 1 uses the same backend at higher resolution followed by Fourier projection as a numerical proxy for R_N^G; an oversampling-reference stability error must be reported. Independent continuum-residual evaluation remains required for closure.
spatial_discretization.honesty_boundary: R_N^C is not called exact Galerkin. Its difference from R_N^G is an aliasing error that must converge to zero.

norms.residual_relative: ||R_N^C-P_N R_ref^C||_L2 / max(||P_N R_ref^C||_L2,1e-30) for the stage-1 same-backend oversampled reference
norms.ritz: real-L2 Rayleigh-Ritz values on a declared projected subspace

required_gates: spectral Galerkin residual versus continuum residual
Hessian/Ritz grid convergence under an isolated-cluster condition

stage1.manufactured_field: analytic, nonzero-density, three-component complex trigonometric field with all Class-II channels active

time_manufactured.forcing: S_N(t)=partial_t Psi_star_N(t)+R_N^C(Psi_star_N(t)); this isolates temporal order for the semidiscrete ODE

unforced_cross_grid.initial_data: the stage-1 analytic manufactured spatial field
unforced_cross_grid.comparison: project each reference trajectory to the target grid; report reference-grid uncertainty separately

later_stages.finite_time: CLOSED@T3-EXECUTED: forced manufactured solution plus unforced cross-grid trajectory convergence with time error separated from spatial error; 10/10 PASS
later_stages.hessian_ritz: matrix-free real Hessian on nested Fourier subspaces; convergence claimed only for an isolated eigenvalue cluster with residual and gap checks
later_stages.hardware_precision: same frozen cases on CPU complex128, CPU complex64, and CUDA complex64/complex128 when supported; absence of CUDA is reported, not silently passed
later_stages.integrated_release: one-command verifier, immutable JSON evidence, independent operator reproduction, and a published hash manifest

tier_boundary: T3 until all six required gates are closed. N32/N64/N128 solver output alone is not discretization evidence.
